inspiration: A skin marker in the image name decides whether a panel scales: fixed chrome stays crisp, stretchable panels grow. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/themes.src/standard/standard.dat line 5. Use for touch UI scaling at 375 wide.

Every skin ships a large twin with the same element names (high-contrast-large, flat-skin-large, classic-large, modern-large): accessibility as a parallel set, not a broken layout. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/simutrans/themes/high-contrast-large.tab

Theme source is data (.dat and .tab) compiled into a shipped .pak by a build script, a clean split between source and shipped asset. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/themes.src/build_themes.sh

The language table selects the font with a key (PROP_FONT_FILE names the bitmap font for English). A language can change its font without code. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/simutrans/text/en.tab lines 2-3

Music named by mood and role (main theme, B theme, boring afternoon, busy day at the depot, transport chaos): a small set of role cues covers the game state. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/simutrans/music/ (01-Simutrans-Main-Theme.mid, 05-Boring-afternoon.mid, 07-Transport-chaos.mid)
Scenarios as small scripts on a shared base (scenario_base.nut, script_base.nut, new_scenario_template.nut). Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/simutrans/script/ (names only)
One layout with several skins (comic, high contrast, flat, aero, modern, classic): the skin changes the look, not the layout. Ref: /mnt/frankendom-donors/simutrans-simutrans/simutrans/themes/*.tab

briefs.label: Large-type skin
briefs.why: a parallel large set keeps every layout intact when type and touch targets grow
briefs.keep: the same element names in a large twin; a per-element scaling marker
briefs.change: our own palette and corner ornament; scaling by a touch-size rule instead of a fixed factor. Recreate as a clearly distinct original, never a copy

briefs.label: Ink-outline skin
briefs.why: a bold outline makes small panels readable on a phone
briefs.change: the source is CC-BY-SA 3.0, so do NOT reuse its art; build an outline style from scratch with our own accent colour and no speech-bubble shapes. Inspiration only

briefs.label: Jam sting
briefs.why: an uptempo cue for traffic jams tells the player something is wrong without a text box
briefs.keep: one cue per problem state; fast tempo
briefs.change: our own cue for a three-attacker pressure state; a metallic tick rather than a brass line. Recreate from scratch

briefs.label: Quiet ground loop
briefs.why: a slow idle loop tells the player nothing is happening and lets the player rest
briefs.keep: a slow tempo for idle zones
briefs.change: a biome-keyed ambient bed with a crossfade at borders, not a melody. Recreate from scratch

briefs.label: Mission script on a base
briefs.why: missions as small scripts on a shared base class keep mission logic short
briefs.keep: a base script plus per-mission scripts
briefs.change: our zone data as JSON with an optional hook; no scripting language. Recreate as a distinct original
